Who We Are:   
 CAE Vision:  Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness.  
 CAE Defense & Security Mission:  CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.  
 CAE Values:  Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed.  
  
 What We Have to Offer:   
 Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work-life balance  
 A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe  
 Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions  
 Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun!  
  
   Summary 
 Responsible for technical assistance in area of data analytics. Inputs/gathers C-17 MTS data using various data collection instruments, extracts and cleans data to prepare for analysis, and assists with analysis/visualization of the data to provide business and operational intelligence. Responsible for the collection, recording, and retrieval of information. Interprets source documents, verifies accuracy of information, prepares reports, and manages data storage and retrieval systems.  Uses multiple commercial off the shelf (COTS) and proprietary software programs to maintain current databases and develop new training areas. Uses a variety of standard engineering methods and techniques in solving problems. Will be the liaison responsible for implementing new and updated Visual and RADAR databases into existing software baseline.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 
 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 Designs, modifies, develops, and implements C-17 MTS Database systems
 Supports and/or installs software applications/operating systems
 Participates in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software
 Utilizes knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within a particular field
 Relies on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job
 Generates preliminary and detailed designs as required for enhancements or modifications to existing designs, requiring the application of current industry design concepts and utilization of basic technical writing skills 
 Work in close coordination with the MTS TSSC Engineering group to ensure a smooth transition of all phases of software implementation and design on assigned projects
 Work closely with the local Test Engineers and various C-17 Maintenance Subject Matter Experts to evaluate and test database design implementation
 Attends and participates, via teleconference, in weekly and monthly meetings providing project and work status to upper level management and customer audience
 Fosters a "team" environment and works well with peers and both internal and external customers.
 Other duties as assigned
 
 Qualifications and Education Requirements 
 Bachelor’s of Science degree in computer science, engineering, or related field; OR a minimum of eight (8) years related experience
 Minimum of four years of related experience
 Demonstrates understanding of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures
 Demonstrated success in generating preliminary and detailed designs as required for enhancements or modifications to existing designs, requiring the application of current industry design concepts and utilization of basic technical writing skills
 Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment
 Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively
 Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
 Working knowledge of COTS software programs such as Photoshop, Terra Vista, Global Mapper, ArcMap, and other global imaging software
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, MS Project)
 Working knowledge of LINUX, batch files, and the C/C++/FORTRTAN language (preferred)
 Ability and willingness to work overtime, weekends, and varying shifts (when required)
 Applicant will be subject to a US Government investigation and must meet the eligibility requirements to obtain/maintain the required level of security clearance
  
 Security Responsibilities    
 Must comply with all company security and data protection / usage policies and procedures.  Personally responsible for proper marking and handling of all information and materials, in any form. Shall not divulge any information, or afford access, to other employees not having a need-to-know. Shall not divulge information outside company without management approval.  All government and proprietary information will be accessed and stored electronically on company provided resources.    
  Incumbent must be eligible for DoD Personal Security Clearance.   
    Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role.    
   Work Environment    
 • Work is performed primarily in an office or engineering support environment within a training systems facility. 
• Regular communication with engineering, courseware, IT, logistics, and program management teams. 
• Structured workflow requiring precision, organization, and adherence to documentation standards. 
• Occasional interaction with Air Force representatives or external vendors. 
• Limited travel may be required for meetings, deliveries, or documentation related support. 
   Physical Demands    
 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.    
 • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while reviewing documents or working at a computer. 
• Ability to walk through simulator areas, technical spaces, or storage rooms as needed. 
• May occasionally be required to lift or move small boxes, binders, or technical files (typically up to 25 lbs). 
 
 Other Duties    
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for their job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.   
   
 CAE USA Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including disability and protected veteran status, as defined under federal, state, or local laws.   
     
 Applicants needing reasonable accommodations should contact their recruiter at any point in the recruitment process.  If you need assistance to submit your application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at hrops@caemilusa.com  
 
 
 About CAE 
 At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success. 
        
 Position Type                       
Regular
